children: Gold falls in the early Asian trade. Sentiment is likely weighed by escalating tensions in the Middle East, a stronger U.S. dollar and rising bond yields, ANZ Research writes in a note. The prospect of higher energy prices is causing worries about inflationary pressures that could prompt the Fed to hike rates, it adds. Spot gold is 0.15% lower at $4,321.80 an ounce.(kimberley.kao@wsj.com)
